image_description: A side-profile view of a Common Wombat standing on rocky ground near a dark burrow entrance. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad and blunt with small ears and a large nose. Short, powerful legs are visible, supporting its low center of gravity. Green foliage and red flowers are present in the foreground and background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and heavy-set with a substantial, ground-hugging build.
